name: XSight
title: xsight.online
payoff: Connect in AR with one click
shortDescription: XSight revolutionizes social interactions by integrating augmented reality (AR) into social profiles and messaging. It allows users to discover people and places around them by simply using their AR-enabled camera. For example, pointing the XSight camera at a person can reveal their AR hologram profile, enabling instant messaging or social connections. This tool is ideal for users looking to enhance their social experiences in real-world settings.
pros: Visual search for places and people
cons: Dependent on user adoption for value
